units.source_text: 这期间，大竹七段作为名人告别赛的对手，整天幽居在旅馆里。

en.t: During this time, Otake 7-dan, as the opponent in the Master's farewell match, spent his days secluded in the inn.

units.source_text: 对局的日子，傍晚时分中途暂停，他总是马上回到自己的房间给夫人挂电话。

en.t: On match days, when play was suspended in the evening, he would always return at once to his own room and telephone his wife.
